title: Orientation conjecture of Nash-Williams
exact_target: Does twice the undirected edge connectivity always guarantee a directed orientation with the required connectivity, even in infinite multigraphs?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3000059 (AMR-029-0059). CC BY 4.0.
A. Assem, M. Koloschin and M. Pitz, The Nash-Williams orientation theorem for graphs with countably many ends (2024), Introduction, Conjecture 1.2 and graph-connectivity definitions, pp.1--2.
